response.overview: The film is dedicated to the famous Krasnoyarsk stolbist, V.K. Teplykh. The film tells the story of Krasnoyarsk Stolby and the stolbist movement, featuring newsreel footage, reminiscences of V.K. Teplykh and other athletes, stories of training, expeditions, and the importance of stolbism in the lives of Krasnoyarsk residents.
